name: Joystick and rotary encoder
author: Bench Workshop
description: A thumb joystick (KY-023: two knobs and a push button) and a rotary encoder knob (KY-040: clicks round in steps, and pushes). Work them from the run panel.

parts.name: Joystick (KY-023)
parts.description: VRx and VRy give 0 V to +5V's volts as the stick goes left/right and up/down (half in the middle): read them with analogRead. SW joins GND while the stick is pushed in (use INPUT_PULLUP). +5V to 3.3 or 5 V, GND.

parts.name: Rotary encoder (KY-040)
parts.description: A knob that clicks round (20 clicks a turn, no end). Each click, CLK goes low and back high; at each change of CLK, DT different from CLK means clockwise. SW joins GND while pushed (use INPUT_PULLUP). + to 3.3 or 5 V (it pulls CLK and DT up), GND. Turn it from the run panel.

examples.name: Joystick steers a servo
examples.description: Move the joystick's left/right slider in the run panel: a servo follows; push it in to centre the servo.

examples.name: Encoder counts
examples.description: Click the encoder left and right in the run panel: the count goes down and up in the serial monitor; push to reset it.
